purpose: Gym equipment recognition from a photo/frame
model_type: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet) + 10-way softmax head, float16 quantised TFLite
labels: 10 classes: squat_rack, barbell, dumbbell, kettlebell, cable_machine, bench, leg_press, lat_pulldown, rowing_machine, treadmill
preprocessing: in-graph [-1,1] scaling; metadata declares mean 0 / std 1
postprocessing: float32 [1,10] softmax; Scan tab shows top-3
training_source: TRAINED BY THIS PROJECT (not vendor/pretrained head)
training_dataset: 1,741 web-crawled photos, deduped by pixel hash, 115-200 per class
metrics: top-1 0.617 / top-3 0.835; per-class table present; leg_press weakest at top-3 0.64
threshold: NOT_CHECKED (live confidence thresholds are in the scanner code)
used_in_production: YES - asset_bootstrap.dart:20 copies it to the documents dir; MlKitVisualEquipmentService loads it via ML Kit LocalLabelerOptions
checksum: NOT_CHECKED (no checksum recorded alongside the artefact)
reproducibility: PARTIAL - training code and hyperparameters documented, dataset itself not in the repo
issues: COVERAGE GAP: 10 model classes against 69 registry machines (14.5%). A documented data leak was caught and fixed during training (non-stratified split via mismatched shuffle seeds; first run reported an inflated 0.774). README states web-crawled photos make the table an upper bound for real gym use.
